AIHOT reference acknowledgment
https://github.com/KKKKhazix/AIHOT
Reference commit: 885b736dc0fd3ef3d4c9c70af2bc3a981a99ff38

Leziwu independently implements the public RSS index and time-decay ranking
in Python/React. Its initial subscription list is based on AIHOT's public
industry/sources.json examples. No AIHOT hosted API/feed data, logo, fonts,
database, commercial operating source list, or branded interface is included.
Third-party article content remains owned by its publishers. Public service
rules and code license are separate; see https://aihot.news/terms.
